data.one_liner: Embedded NoSQL JSON document database for pure Dart and Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides an embedded, NoSQL document-style database supporting JSON documents, blobs, encryption, SQL++ queries, full-text search, and data synchronization. It runs across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need a robust, local NoSQL document database in a pure Dart or Flutter app.
You require advanced features like SQL++ queries, full-text search, and data synchronization.
You need to store and observe complex, deeply nested JSON structures locally.
avoid_when: You only need simple key-value persistence and prefer a lighter dependency.
You strictly require a relational SQL database without document store complexity.
strengths: Cross-platform support spanning mobile and desktop operating systems.
Rich querying capabilities using SQL++ and full-text search.
Supports live queries and database change notifications.
weaknesses: Heavier footprint compared to basic key-value stores.
data.setup_notes: Standalone Dart and Flutter with no manual setup required, just add the package.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer a traditional SQLite relational database interface over a NoSQL document store.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want a type-safe SQL database builder for Dart and Flutter.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: You only need simple key-value storage for small configuration settings.
